post.description: Register operator sensor measurements when running in manual adapter mode.

post.summary: Predict crop nutrient deficiencies or operational status from sensor readings
post.description: Accepts crop type and sensor telemetry with units. Validates physical plausibility and engineering units, executes promoted model inference, and returns calibrated prediction with display label, model metadata, and agronomic limitations.

post.summary: Predict foliar conditions and nutrient deficiencies from plant images (T6-007, T6-014, T6-015)
post.description: Accepts crop type, required input_mode ('leaf' or 'plant'), optional model_family override, and an image file (multipart field 'file' or 'image') or use_campus_frame=True. Executes non-blocking per-leaf instance segmentation and classification off the event loop.

post.summary: Multi-modal crop diagnosis across sensor and image evidence (T6-011, T6-014)
post.description: Executes whichever modalities were supplied (sensor telemetry, foliar imagery, or live campus frame). Supports partial success: failure in one modality does not block the other. Discloses omitted or failed modalities in not_assessed[]; never outputs a merged confidence score.

AnalyzeResponse.title: AnalyzeResponse
AnalyzeResponse.description:
Comprehensive response for multi-modal POST /analyze (T6-011).

Invariants (Overview §19):
- Image and sensor predictions are returned separately.
- No merged or averaged confidence score; no combined severity score.
- No subjective or arbitrary 'contradiction' alerts.
- If one modality fails, the available modality still returns cleanly.
- not_assessed[] discloses skipped or failed modalities with explicit reasons.

PredictionResponse.title: PredictionResponse
PredictionResponse.description:
Comprehensive prediction response payload for sensor and image modalities.

Directly implements TECH_RULES API Standards (v1):
`crop, modality, predicted_class, display_label, confidence, confidence_semantics,
uncertain, experimental, model_id, model_version, timestamp, provenance, warnings[], limitations[]`

PredictionSummary.description:
Discrete counts summary across extracted leaf instances.

NOTE: In accordance with TECH_RULES Rule 16 and PRD, per-leaf predictions
are NEVER averaged into a single confidence score.
